bio.text: Brian Shaver, a Democrat, won the May 2026 primary for Ohio's 5th Congressional District and faces Republican Rep. Bob Latta in the November general election.
He teaches social studies at Fostoria City Schools and is president of Fostoria City Council, which he joined in 2013 as an at-large member.
He earned a degree in history and secondary education from Bluffton University and completed a master's in educational leadership in 2023; he told the Richland Source he lives on a working farm.
